about: Qwen3.5-4B, the paper's base-to-instruct ReLU steers and LoRAs, seeds 1-3: theta_C (constitution) and theta_K (control), with a safety-refusal ReLU steer and LoRA (distilled from a safety-refusal system prompt on the instruct checkpoint) as the unrelated reference. Per-pair, per-layer overlaps of the LoRA updates' output and input spaces and cosines of the ReLU steers' read and write vectors, with the LoRA overlaps' random-subspace null; bound to the objects by sha256.

judge.note: judge-free: weight geometry of the fitted objects; no generation is graded, so no judge enters any number here

provenance.figure_build: the geometry analysis's figure build, outside this repository; its files are named relative to its output directory, each with its sha256. Panel (a)'s shares are the weight lane's one-sided overlaps, recomputed there from the object files; panel (b)'s cosines were computed there from the object files

checks.layer12_cosines_equal: relu_arditi_cosines.json, 30 values, to 8 significant digits (the pairs file's precision)
